mechanism: Primidone induces hepatic metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, potentially reducing penicillin VK levels, though penicillin VK is minimally metabolized; conversely, penicillin may displace primidone from protein binding and increase its CNS effects.
action: Monitor for reduced antibiotic efficacy and primidone toxicity symptoms (ataxia, dizziness); consider alternative antibiotics less affected by enzyme induction or increased penicillin dosing if necessary.
